items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Roy Evans played with Sam Morgan. Oh, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] David Jones had a six-piece band. Poin-el played alto.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Either, uh, Morgan had a project or Octave. Mm-hmm. I think you was up there. Yeah.
I think that's the night. Joe Bentley was there.
